new.question_text: Con quale nome comparivo nel tuo telefono all’inizio, e con quale compaio adesso?
new.question_text_en: What was I saved as in your phone at the start, and what am I saved as now?

new.question_text: Qual è il posto meno adatto in cui abbiamo avuto la ridarella? E chi ha cominciato?
new.question_text_en: What’s the worst possible place we’ve ever had a fit of the giggles? And who started it?

new.question_text: Il primo messaggio tra noi: chi l’ha mandato, e cosa diceva? Riscrivilo come lo ricordi, errori compresi.
new.question_text_en: The first message between us: who sent it, and what did it say? Write it out as you remember it, typos and all.

new.question_text: Che tempo faceva il giorno del nostro primo incontro, secondo te?
new.question_text_en: What was the weather like on the day we first met, as you remember it?
options_en: No idea: I was looking at you

new.question_text: Da dove viene il nomignolo, o la parola buffa, che usiamo più spesso tra noi?
new.question_text_en: Where does the nickname, or silly word, we use most with each other come from?
options_en: Who knows: it’s always been there

new.question_text: Quando raccontiamo insieme un nostro ricordo, tu che parte fai?
options: Racconto io, con gli effetti speciali
Lascio parlare te e correggo i dettagli
Aggiungo ogni volta un particolare nuovo
new.question_text_en: When we tell one of our stories together, what part do you play?
options_en: I tell it, with special effects
I let you talk and fix the details
I add a new detail every time
I sit back and enjoy your version

new.question_text: All’inizio, chi di noi allungava di più i saluti?
options: Pari: i nostri saluti non finivano mai
new.question_text_en: Back at the start, which of us dragged out our goodbyes the most?
options_en: A tie: our goodbyes never ended

new.question_text: Racconta in tre righe l’inizio della nostra storia, nella tua versione ufficiale.
new.question_text_en: In three lines, tell how our story began: your official version.

new.question_text: Ricordi una volta in cui abbiamo capito due cose diverse dalla stessa frase? Cosa avevi capito tu?
new.question_text_en: Remember a time the same sentence meant two different things to us? What did you think it meant?

new.question_text: C’è una nostra abitudine cominciata per puro caso? Racconta la prima volta: dove eravamo e chi ha fatto cosa.
new.question_text_en: Is there a habit of ours that started by pure chance? Tell the story of the first time: where we were and who did what.

new.question_text: Qual è un piccolo salvataggio tra noi che ricordi bene? Chi ha salvato chi, e da cosa?
new.question_text_en: What’s a small rescue between us that you remember well? Who saved who, and from what?

new.question_text: Pensa a un nostro saluto che ricordi bene, alla fine di una serata o su un binario. Cosa hai fatto nei cinque minuti dopo?
new.question_text_en: Think of a goodbye between us that you remember well, at the end of an evening or on a train platform. What did you do in the five minutes after?

new.question_text: Qual è l’ultima «prima volta» che abbiamo vissuto insieme, anche piccolissima?
new.question_text_en: What’s the most recent “first time” we’ve shared, even a tiny one?

new.question_text: Cosa stavi facendo un’ora prima del nostro primo incontro? Se non lo ricordi, inventa: basta che sia credibile.
new.question_text_en: What were you doing an hour before we first met? If you don’t remember, make it up, as long as it’s believable.

new.question_text: Qual è un’attesa tra noi rimasta negli annali, un ritardo o una risposta che non arrivava? Racconta quei minuti come li hai vissuti tu.
new.question_text_en: What’s a wait between us that went down in history, someone running late or a reply that wouldn’t come? Tell me about those minutes from your side.

new.question_text: Quando ripensi a un momento nostro, cosa ti torna in mente per prima cosa?
new.question_text_en: When you think back to a moment of ours, what comes back to you first?

new.question_text: In quale momento hai sentito per la prima volta di poterti fidare di me fino in fondo? Cosa avevo fatto o detto?
new.question_text_en: When did you first feel you could trust me all the way? What had I done or said?

new.question_text: Ricordi un momento in cui hai provato orgoglio per me? Cosa stavo facendo?
new.question_text_en: Remember a moment when you felt proud of me? What was I doing?

new.question_text: Quale ricordo nostro ti dà coraggio quando ne hai bisogno?
new.question_text_en: Which memory of ours gives you courage when you need it?

new.question_text: C’è un momento nostro che, secondo te, io ho vissuto in modo molto diverso da te?
new.question_text_en: Is there a moment of ours that you think I experienced very differently from you?

existing_en.question_text_en: What’s an ordinary day of ours that you’d happily live again, precisely because there was nothing special about it?
What’s the first thing about me that stuck with you, before you even really knew me?
Was there a moment when you realized things between us were getting serious? What were we doing?
Which of our phrases, inside jokes or made-up words would you use to explain the two of us to someone?
If you could relive just one evening we’ve spent together, which would you pick, and would you change anything?
What’s a time I did something you never saw coming from me?
Thinking back to our beginning, what do you miss most about that time?
options_en: Not knowing everything about you yet
Nothing: I like us better now

existing_en.question_text_en: What’s a place you can no longer see without thinking of us?

options: Non sapere ancora tutto di te
fixes.reason: «dell’altro» è maschile e indica la persona partner, quindi viola la regola del linguaggio inclusivo (il validatore non lo intercetta per via dell’elisione «dell’»). Cambia solo la seconda opzione.
